name: Maroma, A Belmond Hotel
positioning: Belmond beachfront hotel between jungle and sea on the Riviera Maya, redesigned by Tara Bernerd with Mexican craft and materials
best_for: Travelers who want a beach retreat rooted in Mexican craft and Mayan culture
Guests who enjoy chef-led dining and a Guerlain spa

facts.text: Architect Jose Luis Moreno began by building a restaurant between the jungle and sea, then added rooms and suites over the years for friends and family.
Interior architect Tara Bernerd led the redesign, working with local artisans.
All construction materials of the redesign (wood, stone, iron and ceramic) were sourced from Mexico.
Casa Mayor echoes Moreno's original restaurant, with original features preserved.
Maroma Spa by Guerlain draws on the resort's history of Mayan wellness philosophy and offers sound and healing rituals.
The resort has Freddy's Bar and a second bar, Bambuco, described as a playful, vibrant Mexican space for sundowners.
Maroma is thirty miles south of Cancun.
The curved stucco buildings are aligned to Mayan geometry.
Casa Mayor, from Mexican-born chef Daniel Camacho, uses ingredients from the Yucatan peninsula and is where breakfast is served.
Each guest is checked in by a personal host, via iPad.

highlights.text: Architect Jose Luis Moreno built the original hotel without blueprints, using free-flowing designs sketched into the sand.
Woodend, a restaurant from Australian chef Curtis Stone, focuses on seafood cooked over an open flame.
Maroma works with Fundacion Selva Maya and Mayahuum to protect the endangered Melipona bee, the stingless bee sacred to the Mayan people.
80 percent of the property's furnishings and objects were made in Mexico.
An excursion to a cenote about a 30-minute drive away is offered, with a guide from 4World Expeditions.

considerations.text: The property is reached along a modest gravel road winding through mangroves off the main highway.
WhataHotel notes the secluded location requires transportation for off-resort activities.
WhataHotel notes premium luxury pricing reflecting the exclusive positioning.
